name: aria-health
description: System health checks, self-diagnostics, and auto-recovery for Aria services.
author: Aria Team

tools.name: check_system
tools.description: Run health checks on all Aria services and return status summary.

tools.name: check_service
tools.description: Check health of a specific external service (real check, not a self-status stub).

tools.name: get_last_check
tools.description: Get the result of the last health check.

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.description: Get collected health metrics and statistics.

tools.name: get_full_status
tools.description: Comprehensive live self-introspection: service status (api/chat/litellm/postgres), cron job health, agent pool status, skill health score, and whether the LLM circuit breaker or a rate-limit/quota condition is currently blocking calls. This is the same data the human-facing Architecture Overview dashboard shows.
